meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation review orchestrator. Launches 5 parallel background sub-agents: Oracle (goal/constraint verification), Oracle (code quality), Oracle (security), unspecified-high (hands-on QA execution), unspecified-high (context mining from GitHub/git/Slack/Notion). All must pass for review to pass. MUST USE before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work. Triggers: 'review work', 'review my work', 'review changes', 'QA my work', 'verify implementation', 'check my work', 'validate changes', 'post-implementation review'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动并行审查已完成工作的质量、安全与目标一致性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在提交PR前自动进行多维度审查
copy.tagline_en: Automatically review completed work across quality, security, and goal alignment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated multi-dimensional review before PR submission

howto.what: 安装后,在交付代码前,Claude 会同时派出 5 个后台审查员:核对目标是否达成、检查代码质量、检查安全性、实际运行软件测试、翻阅项目背景资料。全部通过才算通过,任一失败即整体失败。
howto.when: 当你明确要求检查已完成的工作(如说“review work”“QA my work” 等),或正要提交 PR 前,会触发。

say.text: 帮我 review work,检查这次全部改动
say.note: 5 个审查员并行启动,都要通过才过。

say.text: QA my work,实际跑一遍看有没有问题
say.note: 会真的运行软件来测试行为。

say.text: check my changes,也看下代码质量和安全性
say.note: 覆盖目标、代码、安全三项核查。

howto.what_en: After install, before a code handoff Claude launches 5 parallel background reviewers: goal check, code quality, security, hands-on app testing, and context mining. All must pass; any one failure fails the review.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask to review completed work (e.g., 'review work', 'QA my work', 'check my changes') or right before a PR handoff.

say_en.text: Help me review work and check all my changes.
QA my work — run it and see if anything breaks.
say_en.note: Actually runs the app to test behavior.

say_en.text: Check my changes, including code quality and security.
say_en.note: Covers goal, code, and security checks.
